task: Adaptive organization blob budget with echo-driven retry and status visibility
resume_instruction: Implement default 5200/current persistent org blob budget. Exact echo-confirmed budget-sized delivery may raise current by 50; missing echo lowers by 50 and queues the failed org reply for a 3-second delayed retry, rebuilding blob pages at the smaller budget where metadata is available. Show current(default), evidence and retry state in #status. Preserve exact echo proof, guest/tell limits and owner build/live-test boundary.
